description: This file contains implementation of the Control class and related factory functions for the Rialto client, including methods for creating and registering control clients, with logging and exception handling.

classes.name: Control
classes.description: Implements control client registration and management, including constructor, destructor, and registration method.

methods.description: Registers a client with the control, with exception handling and logging.
